notes.title: MkIVb hotfix: Come back, BOMB is easy now!
notes.content:
[h1]ːresistanceː New features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Indeed, the game is hard, so we've added an [b]Easy mode[/b] option in the "General" tab of the options menu. This only changes the difficulty in off-line game modes. It may need some adjustments so [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions]feedback is welcome[/url].
[*]Added an [b]Aim assist[/b] option in the "HUD" tab of options menu. This will display a "prediction" gunsight telling you where to aim to successfully shoot at enemies. Only active in off-line modes too.
[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/08/2015-08-07_00002.jpg[/img]
[*]The [i]Billby[/i] is now fitted with a - silly - [b]landing gear[/b] :)
[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/08/2015-08-07_00010.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1] ːresistanceː Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]A common crash during Act 2 mission transitions has been fixed
[*]Typos fixed and better English translations
[*]Music is now playing in the [i]"Welcome to Sidi Bandar"[/i] intro
[/list]

[h1]  ːwinoː Thank you [/h1]

notes.title: Note about the crash reporting.
notes.content:
We have received numerous e-mails about the game crashing a first launch on Windows, with a game version that is not up to date.

This crash has already been fixed in a patch, and if you're in this case, [b]please check for updates.[/b] To do so, simply restart Steam.

[b]In any case, please always send us the crash-report with your e-mail address: we'll then be able to tell you how to by-pass the issue if it's critical.[/b]

Thanks,
La Moustache Stutio.

notes.title: Mk IV RC5
notes.content:
This patch is mainly about performance and rendering improvements.

[h1]All platforms[/h1]
[list]
[*]Overall performance improvements.
[*]Better stability
[/list]
[h1]Windows[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an option to change the renderer used by the game. See note below
[*]The game is now compatible with Windows XP
[/list]
[h1]Linux & Mac Os[/h1]
[list]
[*]Better shadow quality
[/list]

[h1]Important note
[/h1]
With this patch, Windows users now have the choice to play in Direct X11, DirectX9 or OpenGl mode.[b]

[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/04/api.jpg[/img]
By default, the game uses DirectX 11 renderer, which was was the one used before. Performances are by far better in DirectX 9, so if you are experiencing framerate issues, please try this mode. Rendering quality should be almost the same, except some minor details regarding shadows.[/b]

The OpenGL mode is also pretty fast (faster than DirectX 11) under windows on both AMD and nVidia cards.

However, on linux, we still recommand people to own an nVidia as their linux drivers are more optimized, especially for older cards.

About the shadow improvements in OpenGL,  a pic is worth a thousand words, so here is a "before/after"  picture of the shadows in OpenGL mode.

[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/04/before_after.jpg[/img]


We're still working on the mission creation tutorial. It's quite complicated as we want it to be as clear as possible. This tool is powerful and therefore not very friendly to use, that's why it takes so much time :)

notes.title: Mk IV RC1
notes.content:
Hi,

This is it ! The [b]OSX[/b] version has landed ! Bring out the [i]Champagne[/i] !

[b]WARNING:[/b]There still may be some issues with the OSX version.
A known issue is that [u]the game may not exit properly[/u], a workaround is to press [i]cmd[/i] + [i]alt[/i] + [i]esc[/i] and force the app to quit.
If you have trouble please tell us about it in the support forum or send us an e-mail to [b]support@lamoustache-studio.fr[/b]

This patch is meant to be the last one before we get out of the early access. 
Of course, this doesn't imply we'll stop to [b]improve the game or to add new features[/b].

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]OSX Version !
[*]Added a small altimeter to the HUD
[*]Added a button "Next skin" on the aircraft selection menu. You can still change the skin using "up" and "down" keys
[/list]

[h1]Cockpits[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Added a cockpit for the Chikara CK50 Kani[/b]
[*]Reworked the cockpit of the S.N.A.F Rorqual
[*]Complete rewriting of gauges shaders, they are nicer now. You might need to remove the shaderCache.bin file
[*]Fixed reflector sight's rendering for the Linux version
[/list]

[h1]Multi-player[/h1]
[list]
[*]Major rebalancing of all aircraft
[*]Added DM and TDM maps for the Tuscany environment
[/list]

[h1]Bug-fix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a visual bug with the landing gears 
[*]Fixed a random crash
[*]Fixed the Libelle tail control animation
[/list]

The CK50 Cockpit:
[img]http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2015/02/Chikara-Cockpit.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update MkIIIt
notes.content:
Well, it seems we have a few more letters in the alphabet, so we decided to use at least one of them before releasing the Mk IV !

This update contains two major changes:
[list]
[*]We've added some kind of [b]"return to base"[/b] objective in missions where it makes sense. This was a long time requested feature, and it is now implemented.
To go to the next mission you know have choice either to open the menu and select "next mission" as before or land/sea-land to a specific point.

[*][b]Airships are  now destructible in multiplayer[/b]. These are the first objects (apart from aircrafts) to be destructbile, and the buildings/ground vehicles/ships will come later, along with the external payloads.
Why are we doing this ? Well, it's kinda easy to understand: we are going to add new multiplayer game modes with more varied objectives, such as some kind of "airbase defense".
[/list]

We've also fixed some little bugs here and there:
[list]
[*]The icon/labels/objective markers position in triple screen mode is now correct.
[*]The mouse cursor can now go everywhere in oculus mode.
[*]Mouse look is now disabled in oculus mode.
[*]Minor shadow improvements and speed-up in both Direct3D and OpenGl.
[/list]

notes.title: Update MkIIIr - Hopefully the last before MkIV
notes.content:
[h1]tl;dr; BOMB will come out from early access on January 2015.[/h1]

We have missed our December release window (i.e. before Steam’s Christmas sales) because the Mac version is not ready for prime time. So close to the end, it’s very important for us to release the game in a suitable state.

Also, we are experiencing trouble making the dedicated server work on Steam, but it’s getting solved. Expect it in a few days. However, before it's available for everyone, we'll try to have one on-line as often as possible.

Changelog isn't as amazing as one might expect:
[list]
[*]It's now possible to turn engines off and on again © (but that won't solve any problem if the engine is broken), default binding is set to 'i' key.
[*]Servers can now be password protected.
[/list] 
[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
We've made a first [url=http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/2014/12/17/custom-skin-creation-tutorial/]customization tutorial about how to create your own skins.[/url]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
The [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/0/619574421268082193/]FAQ[/url] has also been updated.

Happy holidays and don't forget to gift BOMB all around you!

notes.title: Update MkIIIp
notes.content:
Hi,

We've just released the Mk IIIp patch for BOMB. This patch is mostly related to "mouse control" but also brings some UI improvements.

Here is the complete changelog:
[list]
[*]New mouse control code. Still not perfect but [b]MUCH BETTER ![/b]
[*]Added a mouse look toggle key (default: "l alt") to enable mouse look when using mouse control
[*][b]Added a new first person view without cockpit[/b]. Press multiple times the "cockpit" view key/button (default "F1") to enable it. Also available for aircraft that do not have a cockpit yet
[*]Added an option to change icons opacity
[*]Added an option to display distance to enemy aircraft
[*]Moved the icons size and opacity sliders to the "HUD" tab of the options menu
[*]Keys and buttons options are now sorted alphabetically
[*]Fixed icons position
[*]Fixed joystick slider axis preview in the options menu
[/list]

Suggestion for the keyboard setup when using mouse control (if you're right-handed)
[list]
[*]Use WASD keys to manage roll and thrust
[*]Use Q and E for the yaw

notes.title: The Flare Path: Learns To Stop Worrying And Love BOMB
notes.content: It has come to my attention that some Flareopaths are not obeying all 1405 tenets of The Flare Path Pledge. I have it on good authority that last Saturday a reader from Leeds watched Battle of Britain from beginning to end without wincing slightly every time an Me 109-impersonating HA-1112-M1L ‘Buchon’ appeared. Incredibly, I’ve also heard of cases where FPs have referred to railway stations as ‘train stations’ and failed to genuflect when Donald Featherstone was mentioned. Most disturbing are the reports that some of our brethren are routinely ignoring Tenet 933. Yes, it seems there are those among us who, on spotting a ‘We need a Crimson Skies sequel!’ forum post, stay silent instead of pointing out that a spiritual sequel already exists. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: BOMB MkIIIm - Now on Linux !
notes.content:
Hi,

The [b]BOMB MkIIIm[/b] version is on-line, this is a major update, as the game is now available on [b]Linux[/b], and also includes a [b]new environment[/b] inspired by the Tuscany, which is still work in progress, but already gorgeous.

We've also made a dedicated map for the race multi-player mode, which is getting better and better, although it still needs some work. More maps will come.

Finally, the game should be playable on Windows XP, thanks to the OpenGL port we've done for the Linux version.

[b]WARNING:There is no crash report system on Linux. In case of crash, please send us the Ogre.log and Platypace.log files to our support address: support@lamoustache-studio.fr or tell us about it in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/1/]steam forum.[/url][/b]

[b]WARNING2: In case of graphic bug or glitch with the Linux version, please tell us about it in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/1/]steam forum.[/url][/b]


[h1]Changelog:[/h1][list]
[*]Linux support
[*]Added a new environment
[*]Added a new map for the race game mode
[*]The team color is now displayed on aircraft ailerons in Team-dogfight
[*]Optimizations
[*]Various crash fixes
[/list]

[h1]What's next ?[/h1]

Now we will work on the MacOS port, and also add more content to the game, such as new maps, aircraft and other cool stuff.

notes.title: Update Mk IIIi
notes.content:
Hi,

This time we won't write a laconic change log about what has been done in the patch, but rather explain more precisely what has been fixed and what we are working on.

[b]The fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]We've made a few changes recently both to optimize memory consumption of the game and to make the game runs on Linux. Although the Linux version is not available right now, its development impacts the Windows version as most of the code and resources are common.

Because of that the last patch (Mk III[b]h[/b]) had some issues with the ocean and trees rendering when restarting a mission, [b]this is now fixed.[/b]

[*]We've also fixed a problem with the Track-Ir when the track-clip was out of the captor's sight.
[/list]
[b]The improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/1/613936673532897888/]According to some feedbacks[/url], we've added a little black outline on some of the HUD elements to make them more visible.

[*]Another commonly asked feature is [b]checkpoints[/b]. The previous patch added one checkpoints in most of missions, which avoids the introduction phases when restarting the mission after a game-over.

[*]For the few and lucky players having a triple-monitor setup, we've also added a new option, named [b]HUD width[/b], allowing you to slightly change the HUD horizontal position, which may be necessary if the screens don't have the same resolution settings. This option is not really ergonomic yet and we are looking for better ways to do it, but it should do the job.


[/list]

[b]We are also aware some people want to try the multi-player[/b], and as there is unfortunately not enough players worldwide yet, we are looking for a way to organize some kind of event to make them meet.
As the multi-player mode stress-testing is also a reason for why we are releasing the game in early access, we really need it to be played :)

Finally, as the game is becoming more and stable, we will release updates less frequently, allowing us to make deeper and cleaner changes to improve the game. But don't be afraid, in case of major troubles we'll do a patch as soon as possible, otherwise we'll keep the rate of one update a week.

notes.title: The game crashes, how to help?
notes.content:
As this is the very beginning of the early access process, users may experience crashes.

In most of cases, when a crash occurs, you are asked  to send a crash report, which will give us all sort of information about your hardware and what's happening in the game.

This screen looks like this: http://blog.lamoustache-studio.fr/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2014/08/report.jpg
Please provide a description and optionally an email address (so we can write to you when it's fixed)

But in rare cases this pop up isn't displayed, and we won't receive the crash report. In such case, please include:
[list]
[*]information about your computer hardware (OS version, graphic card, system memory...)
[*]where in the game the crash occurred
[*]the [b].log[/b] files located in the [/i]STEAM_INSTALL_DIR[/i][b]/Steam\SteamApps\common\BOMB\Bin\Release[/b] directory
[/list]

Send a mail with these at support@lamoustache-studio.fr or create a topic in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/301500/discussions/1/]Support forum[/url]. As you wish.

Thank you very much,
La Moustache Studio
